posts.text: I am excited to announce that I will be joining TD Bank this fall as a Quality Engineer Intern. Really grateful for the opportunity and excited to learn from the people around me, get some hands on experience, and see what I can accomplish over the next few months. Big thanks Ayush Parekh and Mira Toffoli for supporting me throughout the process. Couldn't have done it without them. Now lets see if we can cop that return offer 🔥
